effect.name: GM Highlight Recovery
effect.desc: Reconstructs clipped highlights using local chroma and a smooth luminance shoulder.
effect.shader: const vec3 L=vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722);void main(){vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);float y=dot(s.rgb,L);float m=smoothstep(threshold,1.0,y);float compressed=threshold+(1.0-threshold)*(1.0-exp(-(max(y-threshold,0.0))/max(1.0-threshold,0.0001)));vec3 chroma=s.rgb/max(y,0.0001);vec3 rec=mix(vec3(compressed),chroma*compressed,chromaPreserve);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(s.rgb,rec,m*amount),s.a);}
